info.name: Order Service
info.description: Friend on Campus Order API. Set the `token` collection variable to a User Service access token with session role REQUESTER before running Create Order. Never commit a real token.

exec: // Pickup deadline one day from now, so Create Order always sends a future deadline.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Collect printing",
  "description": "Grab my printout from COM1",
  "pickupLocationId": "9fd58f13-c8d5-4320-b757-7893d69a4ae0",
  "pickupLocationName": "COM1 Print Shop",
  "dropoffLocationId": "eb46dc78-e25e-4f07-a7a2-26bff615d170",
  "dropoffLocationName": "UTown Residence",
  "creditReward": 10,
  "pickupDeadline": "{{pickupDeadline}}"
}

request.description: Requires a REQUESTER session token. Expect 201 with the order in PENDING_CREDIT; requesterId is the token's sub.

body.raw:
{
  "version": {{version}},
  "title": "Collect printing",
  "description": "Grab my printout from COM1",
  "pickupLocationId": "9fd58f13-c8d5-4320-b757-7893d69a4ae0",
  "pickupLocationName": "COM1 Print Shop",
  "dropoffLocationId": "eb46dc78-e25e-4f07-a7a2-26bff615d170",
  "dropoffLocationName": "UTown Residence",
  "creditReward": 12,
  "pickupDeadline": "{{pickupDeadline}}"
}

request.description: Requires a REQUESTER session token and an OPEN order (Credit must have reserved it). Full replace: every field plus the `version` last read (set `version` from a GET). Expect 200; a changed creditReward shows as pendingCreditReward until Credit confirms. 409 VERSION_CONFLICT carries currentVersion; 409 REWARD_ADJUSTMENT_PENDING while a change awaits Credit.
